4. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants- Krishna Raj Singh, Chandra Lal Singh, Smt. Daswanti Devi, Dilip Kumar Singh and Smt. Usha Devi, with the following prayers:
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to- (1).

To quash the charge sheet no. 314 of 2014 dated 27-07-2014 in Case crime No.
602 of 2014 Under Section. 498A and 323 I.P.C. Police Station Kotwali District Banda on which the cognizance was taken by the court below (C.J.M. Banda) vide order dated 17.11.2016.

This matter was referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court vide order dated 07.02.2017 subject to deposit of Rs. 30,000/-by the applicants.
As per report of the Mediation Centre dated 07.04.2017 the applicants have not deposited the said money before the Centre till 06.04.2017.
6. In view of the same, this matter is reported by the office through the report dated 03.03.2025 of Registrar (J) (Listing) that it is likely to be infructuous.
7. Perused the records.
